```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps
on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "package.json"
      - "AGENTS.md"
      - ".github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "package.json"
      - "AGENTS.md"
      - ".github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml"

jobs:
  generate-context:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: moonrepo/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          cache: true
          channel: stable

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "pnpm"
          cache-dependency-path: "pnpm-lock.yaml"

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          pnpm install

      - name: Generate Rust Documentation
        run: |
          cargo doc --no-deps --workspace
          mkdir -p docs/rust
          cp -r target/doc/* docs/rust/

      - name: Extract TypeScript Definitions
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/typescript
          find src -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" | head -10 | xargs -I {} sh -c 'echo "File: {}" > docs/typescript/$(basename {}).md'

      - name: Analyze Code Structure
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/structure
          find src -type f -name "*.rs" | head -20 | xargs -I {} sh -c 'echo "File: {}" > docs/structure/$(basename {}).md'

      - name: Extract Configuration
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/config
          echo "Cargo.toml contents:" > docs/config/cargo.md
          cat Cargo.toml >> docs/config/cargo.md
          echo "package.json contents:" > docs/config/package.md
          cat package.json >> docs/config/package.md

      - name: Map Test Information
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/tests
          find src -name "*test*" -type f | head -10 | xargs -I {} sh -c 'echo "Test File: {}" > docs/tests/$(basename {}).md'

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "AGENTS.md" ]; then
            echo "Error: AGENTS.md not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check for required sections
          REQUIRED_SECTIONS=("Project Overview" "Development Workflow" "Code Conventions" "Testing Strategy" "Common Patterns" "Performance Considerations" "Debugging")
          for section in "${REQUIRED_SECTIONS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "# $section" AGENTS.md; then
              echo "Missing required section: $section"
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Create Context Bundle
        run: |
          tar -czf copilot-context.tar.gz docs/

      - name: Upload Context Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: copilot-context
          path: copilot-context.tar.gz
          retention-days: 7
```
